candidateBaselineAtPlanStart.note: Exact main revision inspected before the migration control-plane branch was created.

knownAlignmentDebt.description: The existing Frosted Neutral Candidate token/CSS layer retains V1.1 teal/amber aura compatibility fields. The proposed V1.2 optical architecture requires Frost/Ice aura families and Ice Blue as the primary atmosphere before RC.

The named Frost White/Ice Blue palette, frost-level semantics, and Full/Reduced/Minimal profiles require rendered implementation and acceptance evidence beyond the machine-readable foundation contract.
No downstream consumer becomes V1.2 conformant until Stable promotion and fresh repository-local consumer evidence.

implementationStages.name: stable-baseline-integrity
requirements: VERSION remains 1.1.0
registry currentStable remains 1.1.0
V1.1 Stable entrypoints remain present and validated
V1.2 remains non-consumer-eligible

implementationStages.name: optical-foundation
requirements: Frost White/Ice Blue optical palette contracted
Clear/Mist/Frost/Dense Frost/Opaque Frost levels contracted
Frost/Ice/Crystal/Content aura families contracted
Full/Reduced/Minimal performance profiles contracted
anti-patterns and visual distribution limits contracted

implementationStages.name: component-and-shell-alignment
requirements: all 32 inherited components retain exact material mappings
five inherited System Shell regions retain exact mappings
reading and consequential surfaces remain Solid/Raised by default
nested backdrop blur remains disabled by default
Universal Search is explicitly reviewed as a V1.2 showcase

implementationStages.name: rendered-optical-implementation
requirements: candidate CSS/runtime consumes optical foundation roles
legacy teal/amber aura compatibility is retired or mapped to Frost/Ice
Light, Dark, and Deep Dark reference scenes exist
visual distribution and gradient restraint are reviewed
web reference evidence is source-pinned

implementationStages.name: accessibility-performance-resilience
requirements: Reduced Transparency is polished and opaque
Increased Contrast strengthens functional boundaries
Forced Colors preserves platform semantics
Reduced Motion preserves task continuity
200%+ text and RTL are validated where applicable
Full/Reduced/Minimal performance profiles preserve identity and hierarchy

implementationStages.name: candidate-to-rc-readiness
requirements: all release-blocking visual defects are resolved
required supported-platform evidence is exact-revision and current
migration documentation and rollback path are current
human optical review approves the exact candidate
all required CI checks pass on the exact head

implementationStages.name: stable-promotion
requirements: governed lifecycle approval is recorded
1.2.0 release identity is exact and immutable
Stable acceptance record is complete
VERSION and lifecycle registry move together
V1.1 remains preserved as prior known-good release

implementationStages.name: controlled-consumer-rollout
requirements: only Stable 1.2.0 is an eligible production migration target
each consumer records exact design-system source/release anchor
each consumer revalidates accessibility, form factor, performance, and product workflows
migration is staged and independently reversible
consumer claims are repository-local and evidence-backed

acceptanceGates.name: Component and System Shell Contract Parity

rollout.broadProductionRule: no consumer is upgraded by declaration; each must independently pass its own acceptance gates

rollback.designSystemCandidate: remove candidate opt-in and continue using V1.1 Stable entrypoints
rollback.consumerAfterStable: restore the consumer's last verified V1.1 integration revision or other recorded known-good revision when rollback criteria are met
